name: Disease Atlas dashboard read model
principles: Geo remains the source of truth.
The dashboard reads entities, relations, relation entities, values, and Sources backlinks from Geo.
Evidence-only relations must be rendered separately from canonical Health relations.
Every displayed imported claim should link to its relation entity and source entities.

gene.dashboardUse: Click a gene to see diseases it is associated with, diseases where it is differentially expressed, pathway context, GO annotations, and provenance for each claim.

drug.dashboardUse: Click a drug to see treating and palliative disease evidence, drug-class membership, and source links.

evidence.dashboardUse: Every row displayed as a claim should be able to open this evidence entity.

source.dashboardUse: Click a source, dataset, or paper to see which claims, entities, and other source records depend on it.

acceptanceQueries.name: TNF gene disease evidence
expect: incoming Associated with relations from at least one curated disease
incoming Upregulates or Downregulates relations when STARGEO evidence exists
outgoing pathway or GO annotation relations where published
each imported relation has Sources and useful evidence/source values

acceptanceQueries.name: Asthma disease overview
expect: treating drugs via incoming Treats and/or Related drugs

acceptanceQueries.name: Source backlinks
expect: backlinks from symptom, anatomy, or disease similarity evidence relation entities
